terminals.name: backend
terminals.command: cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"; set +H; set -a; [ -f .env ] && . ./.env; set +a; pnpm run dev:backend
terminals.description: Express RPC backend on port 3100 (Prisma-backed server actions). Frontend /rpc calls proxy here.

terminals.name: frontend
terminals.command: cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"; set +H; set -a; [ -f .env ] && . ./.env; set +a; pnpm run gen_rpc && npx next dev --turbopack
terminals.description: Next.js dev server on port 3000. Open http://localhost:3000 (storefront) and /dashboard (admin).
